pkgmetadata.longdescription:
NEC's MSL (MMM Script Language) payload for the SX-Aurora TSUBASA MMM daemon: NEC-signed .nec script files under /etc/opt/nec/ve/mmm/msl/ (initialization, throttling, DMA tables, error-log decoding, sensor diagnostics). ve_monitor refuses to start its MMM-Daemon without them ("can not access mmm-config") and aborts if a script fails NEC signature verification.
Split out of the vendor's mmm RPM family exactly as upstream ships it (mmm-msl is a separate RPM from mmm).
